bullets.text: Smart Livestock Monitoring Launched — Boldyn Networks is deploying a private 5G network in West Sussex to enhance livestock monitoring, improving animal welfare and farm resilience amid extreme weather challenges.

Project Gigabit Progress Reported — Building Digital UK announced that over 296,000 premises have been connected under the £5 billion Project Gigabit initiative, aiming to improve broadband access across the UK.

Huawei and HP Patent Agreement — Huawei and HP Inc. signed a multiyear patent cross-licensing deal, enhancing collaboration in Wi-Fi technology and reflecting their respective strengths in innovation and technology.
MWC26 Doha Co-Locates with ITU — The GSMA's MWC26 in Doha will coincide with the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference, uniting global leaders to discuss digital policy and connectivity advancements.
